subject: Implement Crucible block device driver
description:
Phase 3 of Crucible integration: Create kernel block device driver.

Tasks:
1. Implement C++ driver wrapper (drivers/crucible-blk.cc):
   - Pattern from virtio-blk.cc:1-150
   - Implement crucible_strategy (BIO_READ, BIO_WRITE, BIO_FLUSH)
   - Implement crucible_ioctl (BLKGETSIZE64, CRUCIBLE_SNAPSHOT)
   - Device initialization from kernel cmdline
2. Implement Rust driver (rust/crucible-osv/src/driver.rs):
   - CrucibleDevice struct (wraps Upstairs client)
   - FFI functions: crucible_create, crucible_read, crucible_write, crucible_flush
   - Synchronous I/O operations
3. Device registration:
   - Create /dev/crucible0
   - Parse --crucible cmdline option
   - Auto-detect partitions

Critical files:
- drivers/crucible-blk.cc (~300 lines)
- drivers/crucible-blk.hh (~50 lines)
- rust/crucible-osv/src/driver.rs

Prerequisites:
- Task 8 complete (dependencies resolved)

Timeline: 2-3 weeks
